The training loss is written as:

\[
L = L_{\text{recon}} - \lambda_s L_{\text{smooth}} + \lambda_e L_{\text{stretch}}.
\]

If this quantity is subtracted, minimizing the total loss encourages neighboring vertices to become farther apart, which is the opposite of smoothness. This appears to be either a sign error in the paper or an unusual formulation requiring explanation.

If the intended term is a smoothness penalty, the loss should likely be:

\[
L = L_{\text{recon}} + \lambda_s L_{\text{smooth}} + \lambda_e L_{\text{stretch}}.
\]
